question: 单项选择：I don't know _____ to do next. A. what  B. how  C. when  D. A and B
answer: 答案：D. A and B。解析：what/how + to do"做什么/怎么做"。next"接下来"。

question: 单项选择：She showed me how _____ the computer. A. use  B. to use  C. using  D. used
answer: 答案：B. to use。解析：how to use"怎么使用"。the computer"电脑"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I don't know where ______ (go) for help.
answer: 答案：to go。解析：where to go"去哪里"。for help"寻求帮助"。

question: 单项选择：Could you tell me when _____? A. to start  B. start  C. starting  D. starts
answer: 答案：A. to start。解析：when to start"什么时候开始"。疑问词+to do结构。

question: 翻译句子：你能教我怎么做蛋糕吗？
answer: 答案：Can you teach me how to make a cake? 解析：how to make a cake"怎么做蛋糕"。

question: 单项选择：She told me _____ to take. A. which bus  B. which bus to take  C. to take which bus  D. take which bus
answer: 答案：B. which bus to take。解析：which + 名词 + to do"做哪一辆公交"。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：This book will tell you what ______ (do) next.
answer: 答案：to do。解析：what to do"做什么"。next"接下来"。

question: 单项选择：I want to know who _____ for help. A. ask  B. to ask  C. asking  D. asks
answer: 答案：B. to ask。解析：who to ask"问谁"。for help"求助"。

question: 翻译句子：父母应该教孩子如何面对困难。
answer: 答案：Parents should teach their children how to face difficulties. 解析：how to face difficulties"如何面对困难"。

question: 单项选择：He knows where _____ in this city. A. to go  B. go  C. going  D. went
answer: 答案：A. to go。解析：where to go"去哪里"。in this city"在这个城市里"。
